inUnit.note: Computed by this site from AHS 2023 public-use microdata (unweighted n shown per market). Sampling error is roughly ±2–4 pts for metros. This is not an official Table Creator output; the Table Creator 'Heating, Air Conditioning, and Appliances' table with Tenure=Renter should reproduce it. 'Washing machine' means a washer in the unit. Dryer shares are similar. The ACS does not ask about laundry (only plumbing and kitchen facilities).
inUnit.newConstruction: 88% of multifamily units completed in 2024 had in-unit (individual) laundry; 12% had shared or no laundry. The share has been stable since 2015. Northeast 33% shared/none vs 3% Midwest, 4% South, 9% West. (NAHB Eye on Housing, from Census Survey of Construction, Nov 2025)
inUnit.nmhc: 93% of renters name an in-unit washer/dryer among the most-wanted features (2024 NMHC/Grace Hill Renter Preferences Survey, 172,703 renters).
inUnit.denver: Denver had a record multifamily construction wave: about 18,700–20,000 apartments completed in 2024, inventory +5.7% (RealPage; Apartment Association of Metro Denver), with the pipeline peaking above 44,000 units in mid-2023 (Northmarq). Nationally 88% of new apartments include in-unit laundry, and AHS 2023 shows only 25.5% of Denver renters lack a washer. A link between new in-unit-laundry inventory and Denver's low laundromat density is plausible but unverified: no source found attributes it causally.
